data.title: 银杏叶雨里的蹲身书签
data.location: 铺满金黄落叶的秋日银杏步道
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, oatmeal tweed cropped jacket, ruffled white blouse, burgundy high-waist pleated culottes, brown ankle boots, crouching, holding ginkgo leaf, offering leaf to viewer, bright smile, slight blush, falling yellow leaves, ginkgo trees, leaf carpet, foreground leaves, low angle, wide angle, golden autumn sunlight, crisp shadows
data.animaCaption: Crouching amid a carpet of golden ginkgo leaves in a tweed cropped jacket and burgundy culottes, she holds a pristine fan-shaped leaf up toward your lens with a delighted smile. Low autumn sunlight makes the drifting foliage glow like stained glass overhead.
data.promptProse: Photographed from a low ground-level angle with bright yellow ginkgo leaves scattered across the immediate foreground, Ayachi Nene crouches gracefully on an autumn park promenade. She is dressed in an oatmeal-colored tweed cropped jacket over a ruffle-collared white blouse, high-waisted burgundy pleated culottes, and brown leather ankle boots. Holding an intact golden ginkgo leaf delicately between her thumb and forefinger toward the viewer, she beams warmly as fresh leaves drift past her silver hair under clear, slanting afternoon sunlight.
data.story: 秋风掠过整排银杏树，金色叶片像雨一样扑簌簌落满步道。宁宁在满地落叶里蹲下身，挑出一片形状最工整的叶子举到你眼前——「你看，这片一点缺口都没有！夹进你的课本里当书签吧。」
